services.name: Harbor Cruises
services.desc: Celebrate your bachelorette party in style with a harbor cruise in Charleston. These relaxing and fun-filled cruises provide stunning views of the city’s waterfront, historic landmarks, and natural beauty. With plenty of opportunities for photos, laughter, and bonding, a harbor cruise is a unique and memorable way to mark this special occasion. Departing from the docks on Shem Creek, in the heart of Mount Pleasant, Fishing the Charleston SC coast offers anglers many opportunities to catch a variety of inshore saltwater fish.
